question: Will one fresh stateless call reproduce r04 bounded conformance under the identical prompt, source selection, provider wire and frozen scoring?
hypothesis: The fresh complete answer meets every r04 acceptance item.
disconfirming_result: A complete captured answer fails any frozen acceptance item. Acquisition failure is inconclusive for this hypothesis and is retained.
condition: One replication of r04. No prompt, source, generation-setting or scoring intervention.
asset_selection: Use the unchanged next-protocol-v1 manifest and prompt; historical labels within prompt remain unchanged. r05 identity belongs to the outer relay and ledger, not provider prompt.
scoring: Apply the unchanged byte-hashed r04 SCORING_CONTRACT.json and repaired inspector, followed by semantic review of every acceptance item. QUALIFIED_DECLARATION alone is insufficient.
authorization_caption_interpretation: AUTHORIZED may describe only the supplied current fee-answer task. It cannot assert custody admission, source-authentication authority, onward transfer or hidden-host enforcement. UNKNOWN remains required where the prompt supplies no host/route identity. Same interpretation as the completed r04 review; no literal UNKNOWN authorization value was frozen by r04 scoring.
